# Academic Language Experts

> Professional academic translation, editing, and manuscript preparation services for researchers and scholars worldwide.

Academic Language Experts specializes in helping academics and researchers prepare their work for publication through comprehensive language services. The organization works with leading scholars and institutions including Harvard University, Princeton University, and the Technion - Israel Institute of Technology.

## Key Topics

- academic translation
- academic editing
- manuscript preparation
- scientific editing
- publication support
- proofreading
- multilingual translation
- research preparation
- scholarly communication
- peer review support

## Core Services

- [Academic Language Experts | Academic Translation and Editing](https://www.aclang.com): Homepage for Academic Language Experts offering translation, editing and manuscript preparation services for researchers and scholars.
